versions.content: If Xxx_CompareKey() returns value DCM_E_COMPARE_KEY_FAILED and if the number of failed attempts to enter the requested security level (AttemptCounter) is less than the value configured for the DcmDspSecurityNumAttDelay parameter of the requested security level, the Dcm module shall send a negative response with NRC 0x35 (InvalidKey) and shall not change the Dcm internal security level. Note: if DcmDspSecurityNumAttDelay parameter is not configured, the number of failed attempts to enter the requested security level (AttemptCounter) is not considered.
